releases.name: The Black Lily Blooms in Her Eyes
releases.summary: This adventure game follows the mystery of a bell said to have the power to grant wishes, as you build your deck and challenge six magicians. A roguelike mode with changing routes and item choices also offers strategic battles separate from the story.

releases.name: Tower of Scherbenmark
releases.summary: A turn-based ASCII roguelike RPG set in the fractured dark-fantasy world of Mornhollow. Descend into the Tower of Scherbenmark, utilize a unique hearing mechanic to track dangers in the dark , and uncover the mystery behind your sister Mara's disappearance.

releases.name: Just Anomaly: Hospital
releases.summary: 15 floors. One hospital. How careful can you be while shaking with fear?

releases.name: Cosmo in Tarot: Tarot Study Simulator
releases.summary: Record your insights in a traceable journal, and browse an 78-card reference library. Shuffling uses real-world physical entropy—millisecond keyboard input timings and characters to influence card weights, with no AI interpretation. All readings are for entertainment only, not real-life guidance.

releases.name: First Date
releases.summary: Gathering the courage to ask the girl of my dreams on a first date, I set out to find a gift special enough for her, express a feeling that words can't. Explore a peaceful lake filled with nature, discover 111 unique flowers, and create a bouquet to express your love and create a first date memory.

releases.name: Circulo
releases.summary: A fast-paced 2D arena survival game built around geometric chaos.

releases.name: Hardy & Molly
releases.summary: A lightweight, side-scrolling puzzle-platformer. Players use a liquefier device to alter the state of blocks while navigating platforms, ladders, and mechanisms. The goal is to dodge zombies, gather supplies, and reach the exit. Each level tests observation, timing, and route planning.

releases.name: Hunt Skeletons Together
releases.summary: Take on a cursed church in Hell with 1 to 4 players online — co-op or PvP! Hold the line against running, leaping, bone-throwing hordes. Swing above the dead with your grappling hook. Blast off limbs and unlock cosmetics with every kill. Stand together... or hunt each other down.

releases.name: Turing Heads
releases.summary: Can you and your party find the AI hiding amongst you before it's too late? A social deduction party game dares you to prove it, hilariously, one vote at a time.

releases.name: The Underground Press
releases.summary: A first-person psychological indie horror with investigation elements. Explore the dark, abandoned subway, restore power to machinery, and solve puzzles. Gather clues to uncover the mystery of the closed stations. But remember: you are not alone in the tunnels, and the darkness does not forgive.

releases.name: MEGAKO * PUNCH!
releases.summary: “MEGAKO☆PUNCHI!” is a fast-paced deck-building roguelike!Jump into a world teeming with monsters and beat them to a pulp with your special moves!

releases.name: Horse Magnifier: The Full Horse
releases.summary: this is a game about magnifying horses.
